transcript.en: Hello and welcome to the ﬁlm making podcast.
transcript.zh: 你好，欢迎来到电影制作播客。

transcript.en: In this week's episode, Claire Lemarre talks to us about how to become a makeup artist.
transcript.zh: 在本周的节目中，克莱尔·莱马雷与我们讨论了如何成为一名化妆师。

transcript.en: Claire's been working as a makeup artist in the ﬁlm industry for over 20 years and has lots of useful advice about how to get started.
transcript.zh: 克莱尔在电影行业已经作为化妆师工作了超过20年，并有很多关于如何开始的有用建议。

transcript.en: Thanks Ian. Well, before you can become a makeup artist on ﬁlms you have to spend about 2 years working as a makeup trainee.
transcript.zh: 谢谢伊安。嗯，成为电影化妆师之前，你得花大约2年的时间做化妆学徒。

transcript.en: A good place to get your ﬁrst job would be on a low budget short ﬁlm.
transcript.zh: 找第一份工作的不错选择是做低成本的短片。

transcript.en: Of course, this means that you'll be working for free.
transcript.zh: 当然，这意味着你会免费工作。

transcript.en: But it's often worth it for the experience.
transcript.zh: 但是，通常来说，这样的经历是值得的。

transcript.en: Make sure your transport costs are covered – and remember, there's very unlikely to be any catering provided, so bring plenty of food.
transcript.zh: 确保你的交通费用得到覆盖——并且记住，很可能不会有餐饮提供，所以带足够的食物吧。

transcript.en: If you're lucky, you might start out on a big budget ﬁlm where you'll get the most useful experience.
transcript.zh: 如果你幸运的话，你可能会开始在一个预算较高的电影项目中工作，这样你会获得最有用的经验。

transcript.en: On productions like this, makeup and hair styling are separate departments – so you won't need to bring your curling tongs!
transcript.zh: 在这样的制作中，化妆和发型设计是两个不同的部门，所以你不需要带上卷发夹！

transcript.en: But you're likely to get the opportunity to work with a range of age groups, as well as different ethnicities.
transcript.zh: 但你可能会有机会与不同年龄段的人群以及不同的种族合作。

transcript.en: Doing makeup for special effects is highly specialised, so don't expect to be offered any practical experience in that.
transcript.zh: 为特效做化妆是非常专业的，所以你不要指望在那能得到任何实际的经验。

transcript.en: One problem with working in the makeup department is that it's a high-pressure environment.
transcript.zh: 在化妆部门工作的一个问题是，那是一个高压环境。

transcript.en: There are very few times when you'll be bored or have nothing to do.
transcript.zh: 你可能会感到无聊或者无所事事的情况很少。

transcript.en: It can be stressful but you'll see that the top makeup artists are very professional – even when they're having to work with directors who are impatient, or unhappy with the makeup artist's work.
transcript.zh: 可以让人感到紧张，但你很快就会发现顶级的化妆师非常专业——即使他们不得不与不耐烦或对化妆师工作不满的导演合作。

transcript.en: Follow your supervisor's lead and try to remain calm at all times.
transcript.zh: 跟着你的主管，尽量保持冷静。

transcript.en: I've worked with many very famous actors over the years.
transcript.zh: 我这些年和很多非常著名的演员合作过。

transcript.en: At ﬁrst, I found it overwhelming and could hardly speak, I was so in awe.
transcript.zh: 开始时，我感到非常震撼，几乎说不出话来。

transcript.en: That's preferable, by the way, to becoming too excited and asking for selﬁes.
transcript.zh: 顺便说一句，不如太激动，不要要求自拍。

transcript.en: Now meeting the talent is just a normal part of the job and to be honest most actors don't look that special without all the makeup!
transcript.zh: 现在，与演员见面只是工作的一部分，坦白说，大多数演员在卸妆后并不特别引人注目！

transcript.en: Every makeup trainee will need a makeup kit, which they'll be expected to have with them at all times.
transcript.zh: 每个化妆学员都需要一个化妆包，他们需要随身携带，随时可用。

transcript.en: Just the essentials will do for the kinds of tasks you'll be given – it won't be anything complicated.
transcript.zh: 对于你们将要完成的任务，只需要一些基本的东西就行——不会有什么复杂的东西。

transcript.en: It's worth looking at what the other 98 makeup artists have in their kits – but whatever you do, don't borrow anything without asking ﬁrst.
transcript.zh: 值得看看其他98名化妆师的化妆包里有什么——但是无论如何，不要未经询问就借用任何东西。你们需要建立自己的作品集。

transcript.en: It's very important to build your portfolio.
transcript.zh: 建立作品集非常重要。

transcript.en: You should take photos of all the work you do and ideally show the different stages of makeup application if you can.
transcript.zh: 你应该拍下所有你做的工作，并尽可能地展示不同阶段的化妆应用。

transcript.en: But remember you'll need to get approval from the makeup designer in charge of the department.
transcript.zh: 但记住，你需要得到负责部门的化妆设计师的批准。

transcript.en: As you'll be sending your portfolio digitally, you won't need to get photos printed.
transcript.zh: 因为你将通过数字方式发送你的作品集，所以你不需要打印照片。

transcript.en: So what does a makeup trainee actually do?
transcript.zh: 那么，一个化妆实习生实际上会做什么？

transcript.en: You need to think about whether you're the right kind of person to do the job and whether you'd enjoy it.
transcript.zh: 你需要考虑是否你是做这份工作的合适人选，以及你是否喜欢它。

transcript.en: So, to give you some idea, here are some of the things you might be required to do.
transcript.zh: 为了给你一些概念，以下是一些你可能需要完成的任务。

transcript.en: You may be asked to help prep an actor ready for makeup.
transcript.zh: 你可能需要帮忙准备演员，让他们准备好化妆。

transcript.en: Some actors will arrive having already cleansed and moisturized their skin.
transcript.zh: 一些演员会带着已经清洁和保湿的皮肤到达。

transcript.en: But sometimes you'll need to step in and get this done without wasting any time, otherwise the makeup artist will get behind schedule.
transcript.zh: 但有时候你得自己动手，不要浪费时间，否则化妆师会赶不上进度。

transcript.en: Trainees play a useful role in continuity. It will be your responsibility to take photos, log them digitally and print out a hard copy to put in each actor's ﬁle.
transcript.zh: 学员在连贯性方面扮演了有用的角色。你得负责拍照，数码记录，并打印出一份纸质版放在每个演员的档案里。

transcript.en: This information needs to be kept in good order as a reshoot can mean replicating makeup months later.
transcript.zh: 这些信息需要整理好，因为重拍意味着几个月后还要重新上妆。

transcript.en: General duties mean doing anything from getting the teas and coffees to putting on a wash.
transcript.zh: 职责包括从准备茶水咖啡到洗衣服等任何事情。

transcript.en: Having a positive attitude and being willing to do whatever is asked of you will help you get your next ﬁlm job.
transcript.zh: 保持积极的态度并且愿意去做任何被要求的事情，将会帮助你获得下一部电影的工作。

transcript.en: You won't be asked to apply makeup to any of the principal cast, only the extras.
transcript.zh: 你不会被要求给任何主要演员上妆，只会给一些临时演员化妆。

transcript.en: If there are dozens of extras involved you'll need to keep up a swift pace and not spend too long on each person.
transcript.zh: 如果有几十个临时演员，你需要保持快速的节奏，不要在每个人身上花费太多时间。

transcript.en: It takes quite a lot of conﬁdence to be able to do this well.
transcript.zh: 能够很好地做到这一点需要很大的自信。

transcript.en: OK now about terms and conditions….
transcript.zh: OK，现在关于条款和条件……
